requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "New hire onboarding guide"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Welcome to MoaLogis."}, {"id": 2, "text": "This document walks you through what to do step by step during your first two weeks ▶"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "For questions, please contact Joonho Byun (Joonho Byun), HR manager."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Seojin Um (Seojin Um) will help you set up your development environment."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Day one"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "When you arrive, first collect your access badge at the reception desk on the first floor."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The access badge you received will be registered by Manager Byeon Jun-ho."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Your seat is next to the Dawn Team, and Ms. Eom Seo-jin also sits in the same row."}, {"id": 2, "text": "You'll have lunch with your teammates."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Day two"}, {"id": 1, "text": "On day two you spend the whole day on site."}, {"id": 2, "text": "For unloading work, you observe while wearing safety shoes."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "We do not speak first to drivers who are working."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The experience report goes up to the team lead for approval."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Once you've reviewed it, it will be passed on to Manager Byeon Jun-ho."}, {"id": 2, "text": "First week"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "New MoaLogis hires work through a task list called 'Launchpad' in their first week."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Launchpad item 1 is logging into the wiki and signing up for the internal messenger."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Company announcements and casual chat happen in the 'Hearth' channel."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Onboarding step 2 is taking the Pathfinder training on the fleet allocation system."}, {"id": 1, "text": "You'll build a full day's fleet allocation plan yourself using Pathfinder."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Don't post practice screens in Hearth."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "You don't need to write long reports."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Once you finish the scaffolding, you'll start on real work in the second week."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Your first real task is to get a code review together with Mr./Ms. Eom-seojin."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "We share the code review results in the team channel for 모닥불."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "If you have any questions, feel free to ask Manager Byeon Jun-ho at any time."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Finally, just leave a one-line impression on Modakbul and you're done."}]}
